title: Amazon: Inventory, Recommendations, and Wishlists
description: Add inventory management, product recommendations, and wishlists.

data.text: Extend the e-commerce system with low-stock alerts, product recommendations based on purchase history, and user wishlists.

data.title: InventoryManager and RecommendationEngine
Why simple recommendations work
data.text: Category-based recommendations are surprisingly effective. 'Customers who bought X also bought Y' is a collaborative filtering pattern. Start simple, then add ML.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: InventoryManager tracks stock and triggers alerts
Wishlist is a simple User-Product many-to-many
Low-stock threshold should be configurable per product
data.takeaway: E-commerce personalization starts with simple rules. Recommendations, wishlists, and inventory alerts are the building blocks of a marketplace.
